sections.content:
The game is over. Looking at the current state:
- Row 42: B, w, B, w, w (matches initial pattern)
- Row 44: B, w, B, w, w (matches initial pattern)
Wait, row 44 is B, w, B, w, w too! So both rows match the initial pattern. But the game is over. This is confusing.
Actually wait, let me re-read the segmentation output:
Row 42: B, w, B, w, w
Row 44: B, w, B, w, w
Both rows match the initial pattern. But the game is over. This means the game_over was triggered BEFORE I finished the batch. The batch was:
1. MOUSE(row=42, col=26) - toggled row 42 position 2
2. MOUSE(row=42, col=36) - toggled row 42 position 4
3. MOUSE(row=42, col=41) - toggled row 42 position 5
After action 3, row 42 became B, w, B, w, w. At this point, row 44 was still B, B, B, B, B (from my previous actions). So the game_over was triggered when row 42 became B, w, B, w, w while row 44 was B, B, B, B, B.
But now the segmentation shows row 44 as B, w, B, w, w. This is strange. Maybe the game_over caused row 44 to reset to the initial state?
Actually, looking more carefully at the segmentation:
Row 44: color=B, boundary=[[44, 21], [46, 21]] - this is a vertical bar at column 21
Row 44: color=w, boundary=[[44, 26], [46, 26]] - this is a vertical bar at column 26
etc.
Wait, the row 44 segments are VERTICAL bars (from row 44 to row 46), not horizontal segments like row 42. This is the button representation. The row 42 segments are horizontal (just row 42).
So row 42 is the "display" row and row 44 is the "button" row. When I click on row 44, it toggles the button. When I click on row 42, it toggles the display.
Wait, but earlier I was clicking on row 42 and row 44 and they both toggled. Let me re-examine...
Actually, looking at the boundaries:
- Row 42 segments: [[42, 20], [42, 22]] - horizontal, 1 row x 2 cols
- Row 44 segments: [[44, 21], [46, 21]] - vertical, 2 rows x 1 col
So row 42 has horizontal segments and row 44 has vertical segments. They're different types of objects.
Now, the game is over. I need to figure out how to restart or continue. Let me try clicking on the blue circle to see if it resets the game.
